verdict.rationale: A government corporate registry could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only the web-based Online Filing Centre and a PDF/email/mail fallback, with no first-party CLI. The probe notes the registry documents no transactional API, and the open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate national open-data platform, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
